## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change is needed.

## Invariants and compatibility

Explain any impact on snapshot identity, natural parents, graft reachability,
sync compatibility, provider materialization, API contracts, or migrations.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated regression tests
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make typecheck` when TypeScript changed
- [ ] `make e2e` or a focused equivalent when behavior changed
- [ ] `make public-check`
- [ ] No credentials, private context, personal data, or generated local stores included

## Documentation

- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented
- [ ] OpenAPI/schema changes include drift-guard updates
- [ ] Korean and English UI locale keys remain in sync
